subject: Order #{{order_number}} confirmed — thanks, {{customer_name}} 🎉
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your order #{{order_number}} for ₹{{total}} is confirmed. Track it any time at {{tracking_url}}. — Team {{store_name}}

subject: ✅ Payment received for order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we received ₹{{amount}} for order #{{order_number}}. We will send the shipping details once it leaves our warehouse.

subject: Your order #{{order_number}} is being prepared
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, our team is packing order #{{order_number}}. Expected dispatch: {{dispatch_eta}}.

subject: 📦 Order #{{order_number}} is on the way
body: Your order #{{order_number}} shipped via {{courier}}. AWB {{awb}} — track at {{tracking_url}}.

subject: 🚚 Out for delivery today — order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your order #{{order_number}} is out for delivery. The courier may call {{customer_phone}} — please keep it handy.

subject: Delivered — enjoy your order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, order #{{order_number}} has been delivered. Love it? Leave a review: {{review_url}}

subject: Order #{{order_number}} cancelled
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we have cancelled order #{{order_number}} as requested. Refund of ₹{{refund_amount}} will reach you in 5–7 working days.

subject: 💰 Refund processed for order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we have refunded ₹{{refund_amount}} for order #{{order_number}} to your original payment method.

subject: Update on your order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, order #{{order_number}} is in the final stages of processing. Dispatch is expected in the next 1–2 business days.

subject: Shipping update for your order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, a slight courier delay has affected order #{{order_number}}. We are tracking it closely and will update you soon.

subject: Brief hold on your order #{{order_number}}
body: Order #{{order_number}} is undergoing our standard quality check and will dispatch within 24 hours.

subject: Important update about your order #{{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, one item in order #{{order_number}} is temporarily unavailable. Reply to this email for a refund or an alternative.

subject: Your verification code: {{code}}
body: Your code is {{code}}. It expires in {{ttl_minutes}} minutes. Do not share this code.

subject: Welcome to {{store_name}} 👋
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, welcome aboard. Explore new arrivals: {{store_url}}

subject: Reset your {{store_name}} password
body: Click {{reset_url}} to set a new password. The link expires in {{ttl_minutes}} minutes.

subject: Your {{store_name}} password was changed
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your password was updated on {{changed_at}}. If this was not you, contact support immediately.

subject: Your {{store_name}} address was updated
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your delivery address was changed on {{changed_at}}. If this was not you, contact support.

subject: Email changed on your {{store_name}} account
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your account email was changed to {{new_email}}. If this was not you, contact support.

subject: Delivery address updated for order {{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your request to change the delivery address for order {{order_number}} has been approved. New address: {{address_block}}. View order: {{order_url}}

subject: Address change declined for order {{order_number}}
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we could not approve your request to change the delivery address for order {{order_number}} to: {{address_block}}. {{reason}} Your order will be delivered to the original address. View order: {{order_url}}

subject: We received your KYC — review in 24-48 hours
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, thanks for submitting your KYC documents. Our team will review and get back within 48 hours.

subject: ✅ KYC approved — welcome aboard
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your KYC is approved. You now have full B2B wholesale access.

subject: KYC verification unsuccessful
body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we could not verify your KYC: {{reason}}. Please re-submit: {{resubmit_url}}

body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we received your request for quotation #{{rfq_number}}. Expect our quote within 24 hours. View: {{rfq_url}}

body: A new RFQ #{{rfq_number}} was submitted by {{customer_name}} ({{customer_email}}). Review: {{rfq_url}}

body: Hi {{customer_name}}, your business account application for {{company_name}} could not be approved at this time. {{reason}}
